author: Aaij, R. and others
title: Angular analysis and differential branching fraction of the decay $B^0_s\to\phi\mu^+\mu^-$
abstract: an angular analysis and a measurement of the diﬀerential branching fraction of the decay $B^0_s \to \phi \mu^+ \mu^−$, using data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 3.0 fb$^{−1}$ of $pp$ collisions at $\sqrt{s} = 7$ and $8$ TeV
